injuries.t: LeBron James OUT (low back/sciatica), downgraded from questionable. Embiid likely sits one game of back-to-back. Barlow, Fall, Hukporti out; Wade Q.
Saka, Saliba, Tzolis out
Grealish (ill), Branthwaite (concussion protocol) out
Pep Chavarria out; Malo Gusto returns
QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson OUT (high left ankle sprain), third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts vs Bengals. LB Tavius Robinson (IR) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also out.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).
DeVonta Smith, Nolan Smith, Wicks out Monday vs Cowboys; Barkley questionable.
S Jevon Holland (concussion) and TE Theo Johnson (neck) downgraded to OUT at Texans; Greg Newsome II out; Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
Bulls C Nic Claxton out (hamstring); Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa out (ankle), third straight game.
Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones, Strawther out; Alpha Diallo questionable vs Pelicans.

vs Suns: Curry (knee management), Draymond Green (back), Podziemski (back), Horford (back) out; Butler, Moody, Porzingis also out. Suns: Ighodaro out. Supports Suns -6.5 leg; line likely already adjusted.
C Jalen Duren OUT (right hamstring) at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle). Paul Reed expected to start.
Zach Edey OUT (ankle management, back-to-back) at Kings; Cedric Coward questionable (wrist).
S Jevon Holland, TE Theo Johnson, CB Greg Newsome II out at Texans; LB Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out Monday vs Cowboys.
Courtois (flu) out for El Clásico; Lunin starts in goal. Vinícius Jr suspended.
WR Puka Nacua questionable (calf), will test pregame; Davante Adams out (hamstring); CB Trent McDuffie Q, LB Nate Landman out. Recheck Rams -8.5 before kickoff.
RB Breece Hall questionable/unlikely (quad) vs Dolphins; Braelon Allen expected to lead.
Lamar Jackson confirmed OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts.
Gui Santos - Out: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.
Jalen Suggs - Out: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson - Out: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Rasheer Fleming - Out: Fleming is out for Thursday's game against the Magic due to a sprained left ankle.
Jordan Goodwin - Out: Goodwin (calf) is out for Thursday's game against Orlando.
Mark Williams - Out: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
A.J. Greer - Injured Reserve: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Troy Terry - Injured Reserve: Although Terry's (hip) return doesn't appear to be imminent, he is getting close to playing, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Saturday.
Ian Moore - Injured Reserve: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.
Ryan Poehling - Injured Reserve: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
James Hagens - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Matthew Poitras - Out: Poitras (nose) won't play Thursday in Pittsburgh, per Kevin Paul Dupont of The Boston Globe.
Alexander Nikishin - Out: Nikishin (not injury related) will need some time before he makes his 2026-27 debut, according to Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal on Monday.
Jordan Staal - Injured Reserve: ir
Bowen Byram - Injured Reserve: Byram (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

Patrick Kane - Out: Head coach Jeff Blashill said after Monday's 5-2 loss to the Avalanche that Kane has an upper-body injury and will miss at least the next couple of games, Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
Josh Manson - Out: Manson (ankle) is expected to miss the next eight weeks, Corey Masisak of The Denver Post reports Friday.
Zachary L'Heureux - Injured Reserve: ir-lt
Miro Heiskanen - Out: Heiskanen (upper body) will not play in Thursday's road clash against the Blue Jackets, per Mike Heika of the Stars' official site.
Sam Steel - Out: out
Kyle Capobianco - Injured Reserve: ir
Oskar Back - Injured Reserve: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.
Matt Duchene - Injured Reserve: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.
Luke Krys - Injured Reserve: ir-nr

Marco Kasper - Injured Reserve: Head coach Todd McLellan said Thursday that he expects Kasper (upper body) to return at some point during the Red Wings' upcoming four-game road trip, Max Bultman of The Athletic reports.

Mason Appleton - Injured Reserve: Head coach Todd McLellan stated that Appleton (undisclosed) is expected to return to the lineup during the Red Wings' upcoming four-game road trip, per Max Bultman of The Athletic.

Albert Johansson - Injured Reserve: Head coach Todd McLellan stated Thursday that Johansson (undisclosed) is expected to be sidelined through the team's upcoming four-game road trip, per Max Bultman of The Athletic.
John Gibson - Out: out
Dylan Larkin - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Simon Edvinsson - Injured Reserve: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Tristan Jarry - Out: out
Isaac Howard - Injured Reserve: ir
Zach Hyman - Injured Reserve: ir
Devon Levi - Injured Reserve: Levi (undisclosed) is expected to miss a few weeks, per Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton.
Alec Regula - Injured Reserve: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Matt Savoie - Injured Reserve: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Frederik Andersen - Injured Reserve: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.
Mattias Janmark - Injured Reserve: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.
Atro Leppanen - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Ivan Demidov - Injured Reserve: Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.
Mike Matheson - Out: Matheson (lower body) is expected to miss two weeks, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports Saturday.
Sam Montembeault - Injured Reserve: Montembeault (lower body) is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Saturday.
Bryce Pickford - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Lucas Condotta - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Seamus Casey - Injured Reserve: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.
Mathew Barzal - Injured Reserve: Barzal (knee) practiced Wednesday, but he wore a no-contact jersey, and there's still no timetable for his return, per Stefen Rosner of NHL.com.
Ryan Pulock - Out: out
Matias Maccelli - Injured Reserve: Maccelli (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Calum Ritchie - Injured Reserve: ir
Alexander Romanov - Injured Reserve: ir
Sean Durzi - Injured Reserve: Durzi (undisclosed) was put on injured reserve Thursday, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.
Joonas Korpisalo - Injured Reserve: Korpisalo (foot) was reassigned to AHL Hartford on Wednesday for a conditioning stint, Mollie Walker of the New York Post.
Igor Shesterkin - Injured Reserve: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.
Joe Veleno - Injured Reserve: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.
Aidan Thompson - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Adam Sykora - Injured Reserve: ir
Rasmus Ristolainen - Injured Reserve: Ristolainen (hand) was placed on injured reserve, retroactive to Oct. 24, on Tuesday.
Nikita Grebenkin - Injured Reserve: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.
Elmer Soderblom - Injured Reserve: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.
Bryan Rust - Injured Reserve: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.
Trevor van Riemsdyk - Injured Reserve: ir
Ryan Graves - Injured Reserve: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.
Logan Mailloux - Injured Reserve: The Blues assigned Mailloux (hand) to AHL Springfield for a conditioning assignment Monday.
Torey Krug - Injured Reserve: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.
Dillon Dube - Injured Reserve: ir
Tyler Tucker - Injured Reserve: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

Yanni Gourde - Injured Reserve: Gourde (hip) will miss Thursday's game against Chicago, but he might be available at some point during the upcoming four-game road trip, per Benjamin Pierce of the Lightning's official site.
Nate Schmidt - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Kailer Yamamoto - Out: Yamamoto (upper body) won't play Thursday versus the Canadiens.
John Marino - Injured Reserve: ir
Maveric Lamoureux - Injured Reserve: ir
Tom Willander - Out: out
Filip Chytil - Injured Reserve: Chytil (upper body) won't travel with the Canucks during their upcoming two-game road trip, per Jeff Paterson of CanucksArmy.com.
Akil Thomas - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Mackenzie MacEachern - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Thatcher Demko - Injured Reserve: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.
Parker Wotherspoon - Injured Reserve: ir
Haydn Fleury - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Josh Morrissey - Injured Reserve: Morrissey (wrist) won't play Thursday versus Vancouver, but he hasn't been ruled out for Sunday against Tampa Bay, per Danielle Bain of TSN.
Vladislav Namestnikov - Injured Reserve: ir

Nick Bjugstad - Injured Reserve: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.

conditions.name: v2 higher avg CLV vs FanDuel
v2 higher avg CLV vs Pinnacle
At least 30 top picks graded (each model)

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).
